cheats.name: 4.The more you spend, the more money you get at the store.
cheats.zh: 4.The more you spend, the more 金錢 you 獲得 at the store.

cheats.name: 5.When using items or sell them at the store, the number of it increases by 90.
cheats.zh: 5.When using 道具 or 賣出 them at the store, the number of it increases by 90.

cheats.name: 6.When using items, your ability value will increase by 100.
cheats.zh: 6.When using 道具, your ability value will increase by 100.

cheats.name: 7.When using items, your ability value will increase by 1000.
cheats.zh: 7.When using 道具, your ability value will increase by 1000.
